prompt: The hour hand of a clock sweeps from the 12 to the 4. Through how many degrees has it turned? Give just the number.
hint: A clock face is a full circle cut into 12 equal hour marks.

hints.text: A clock face is a full circle cut into 12 equal hour marks.
Each hour mark is $\frac{360^\circ}{12} = 30^\circ$. How many hour marks from 12 to 4?

explanation: The 12 hour marks split $360^\circ$ evenly, so each gap is $\frac{360}{12} = 30^\circ$.
Going from 12 to 4 crosses four of those gaps.

alternativeExplanations.title: As a fraction of the circle
steps: From 12 to 4 is $\frac{4}{12} = \frac{1}{3}$ of the way around the clock.
